faqs.name: Jonathan Cohen
faqs.review: Our 10-day cycling tour across Sardinia offered an incredible balance of rewarding rides, stunning coastal scenery and charming towns. Highlights included navigating the rugged terrain of Monte Limbara, cruising the breathtaking coastal roads of the Costa Verde, enjoying archeological sites, beach time and a traditional dinner at Sa Mandra. It was a perfectly crafted itinerary that beautifully showcased the island's diverse landscapes and culture. Mike & Peiter, our guides, were friendly, fun & helpful taking great care of our small group.

faqs.name: Stuart Grant
faqs.review: We traveled across Sardinia with Montaraz on an e-bike tour in the last week of September. My first cycle tour with Michael and Montaraz (my wife’s third) and boy did it deliver. Exceptional routes, great accommodation and delicious food. Our guides were so helpful, professional, knowledgeable and truly enthusiastic about sharing the Sardinian landscape and culture. Nothing was too much trouble. Even the weather was fabulous. Highly recommended.

faqs.name: Audrey Nelson
faqs.review: Just returned from another fabulous cycling trip with Montaraz - this time in Sardinia. Michael (ably supported by Pieter) puts so much effort into making the holiday a great experience - the routes allow you to discover the country, lunch stops are delicious, including a visit to a winery, and he even arranged additional activities for the non cycling days - I enjoyed a glorious sunset horse ride along the beach.

faqs.name: Fitness Function
faqs.review: I have done many guided cycle tours and I rate Michael's tours as the best. I have done 3 of them now. One gets a really personal service at a very reasonable price. The routes are well planned with quality bikes and good support. Excellent lunches are supplied and good quality hotels. I travel with friends from mixed nations that I have met on previous tours and we are already planning next year's trip.

faqs.name: Lisa Terry
faqs.review: Montaraz is an exceptional travel experience for a multitude of reasons. First and foremost is the owner, Michael.  I have completed four e-bike trips with Michael. Each one has been exceptional in its own way, the routes, the food, the hotels, and most importantly the friendships that have been built over the years. Michael attracts people that are similar to him; kind, thoughtful, generous, easy to get along with and a lot of fun. We just finished Sardinia and are already planning for next year. You won’t be disappointed.

faqs.name: Scott Emond
faqs.review: There are many ways to see the world when traveling. Montaraz Outdoors provided us with one of the most exceptional and memorable we’ve experienced so far. Every kilometer was a feast for the senses – led by Michael and Pieter – with genuine joy, expertise, and passion. From the warm smile of a local shopkeeper to the dramatic coastal cliffs, we revealed in the freedom to explore the magic of Sardinia while they kept us on track, fed us delicious food, and attended to our gear. Reuniting with friends and making new ones along the way, this was a ride we’ll never forget. If you’re seeking a unique, safe, and exciting adventure, look no further than Montaraz. They get it so right. We can’t wait to go somewhere new with them again. Until then, we’ll be savoring the memories.
